rows.question: How many days of casual leave do employees get in a year?
rows.rawAnswer: Employees are entitled to 8 days of Casual Leave in total per Calendar Year, from January to December [S112].

rows.question: What is the most casual leave I can take at one time?
rows.rawAnswer: Casual Leave should not normally be granted for more than 5 days at any one time [S119].

rows.question: How much earned leave is credited each half-year?
rows.rawAnswer: Earned leave is credited at a uniform rate of 15 days on January 1st and July 1st every year [S180]. The earned leave admissible to an employee of the Institute is 30 days in a calendar year [S179].

rows.question: Up to how many days of earned leave can be accumulated?
rows.rawAnswer: Earned Leave can be accumulated up to 300 days, including the number of days for which encashment has been allowed along with LTC – Rule 26 (1) [S181]. Earned Leave does not exceed 300 days [S188].

rows.question: What is the maximum earned leave that can be taken at a time?
rows.rawAnswer: Earned Leave can be taken at a time up to 300 days as leave preparatory to retirement [S191]. The maximum amount of earned leave that can be granted to an employee at a time is 180 days [S191].

rows.question: How many days of earned leave can be encashed with LTC?
rows.rawAnswer: Encashment of earned leave up to 10 days on each occasion and a maximum of 60 days in the entire service are permissible while availing LTC [S193].

kept.text: Encashment of earned leave up to 10 days on each occasion and a maximum of 60 days in the entire service are permissible while availing LTC.

rows.question: How long is the vacation for teaching staff?
rows.rawAnswer: Teaching staff can avail vacation for 60 days during the period when the semester is closed [S197]. The maximum vacation that can be taken is 60 days [S199].

rows.question: How many days of half pay leave are given each year?
rows.rawAnswer: All permanent employees of the Institute are eligible for 20 days Half Pay Leave for each completed year of service in the Institute [S209]. Every employee shall be credited with half pay leave in advance, in two installments of 10 days each on the 1st January and 1st July of every calendar year [S211].

rows.question: How long is maternity leave?
rows.rawAnswer: A female employee of the Institute with less than 2 surviving children can be granted Maternity Leave for a period of 180 days [S269]. Additionally, Maternity Leave not exceeding 45 days may be granted in case of miscarriage including abortion on production of a medical certificate [S271].

rows.question: How long is paternity leave?
rows.rawAnswer: A married male employee with less than two surviving children can be granted Paternity Leave for a period of 15 days [S282]. This leave can be taken either up to 15 days before the wife's confinement or up to six months from the date of delivery [S283].

rows.question: How long is adoption leave?
rows.rawAnswer: The maximum admissible period of Adoption Leave is regulated based on the adopted child's age [S298]. If the child is less than one month old, leave up to one year may be allowed [S299][S300]. If the child is 2-6 months old, up to 6 months may be allowed, and if the child is 7-10 months old, up to 3 months may be allowed [S299][S300][S301].

If the child is 2-6 months old, up to 6 months may be allowed, and if the child is 7-10 months old, up to 3 months may be allowed.

rows.question: Within how many days must I apply to convert one kind of leave into another?
rows.rawAnswer: The employee should apply for such conversion within 30 days of completion of the relevant spell of leave [S56].

kept.text: The employee should apply for such conversion within 30 days of completion of the relevant spell of leave.

rows.question: After how long of continuous absence is an employee treated as having resigned?
rows.rawAnswer: An employee who remains absent from duty for a continuous period exceeding 5 years other than on foreign service or other service approved by MHRD, whether with or without leave, shall be deemed to have resigned from the service of the Institute [S97]. Without a valid reason, a Government servant who remains absent for continuous period exceeding five years other than foreign seervice, with or without leave, should be deemed to have resigned from Government service – Rule 12 [S62].

rows.question: What is the maximum study leave in the whole service?

rows.question: How many days of child care leave can be taken in the whole service?
rows.rawAnswer: Women employees may be granted Child Care Leave for a maximum period of 730 days during their entire service [S222]. This leave is for taking care of up to two children [S222].

rows.question: What salary is paid during child care leave?
rows.rawAnswer: For women employees, the leave salary during Child Care Leave will be equal to the pay drawn immediately before proceeding on leave [S225]. CCL is granted at 100% salary for the first 365 days and 80% salary for the next 365 days [S228].

rows.rawAnswer: CCL shall not be admissible if the child is 18 years of age or older [S224]. However, for disabled or mentally challenged children, it is permitted for an offspring of any age subject to conditions and submission of certificates [S232].

rows.question: How many days of special casual leave are given for a vasectomy?
rows.rawAnswer: A male employee is admissible a maximum of 5 working days for a vasectomy operation [S110]. If the operation is done for a second time due to the first failing, another 5 days will be admissible upon providing a medical certificate [S111].

rows.question: How much leave can an aggrieved female staff member get during an inquiry?
rows.rawAnswer: An aggrieved female staff member may be granted leave up to a maximum of 90 days [S241]. This leave is granted during the pendency of an inquiry under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 [S241]. The leave granted in this manner shall not be debited against the leave account [S242].
